Vendored from npm `sql.js-httpvfs@0.8.12` (Apache-2.0, see LICENSE), self-hosted
because this site's CSP is `script-src 'self'` -- no CDN scripts allowed.
Only `sql-wasm.wasm`, `sqlite.worker.js`, and the main entry (renamed
`sqljs-httpvfs.js`) are kept; everything else in the npm package (source
maps, TypeScript types, docs) is unused here.
